address: Te Nuku, 43 Ballarat Street, Queenstown, 9348, New Zealand
bio: Rātā, a native tree of New Zealand, symbolises the restaurant’s close ties with the land, as do the wood panelling and furnishings which are inspired by the landscapes of the South Island. The kitchen rolls out modern New Zealand fare crafted with seasonal ingredients from Central Otago, both foraged and farmed locally, and finessed by a savvy touch and solid techniques. Expect bold season-driven flavours.
